newsitem.title: UK: AMP confirms interest in UK's Scottish Amicable.
newsitem.headline: AMP confirms interest in UK's Scottish Amicable.

text.p: Australia's Mutual Provident (AMP) on Friday confirmed it had tabled outline offer proposals to Britain's Scottish Amicable with a view to making a final binding offer for the mutually-owned life insurer.
AMP group development director Jonathan Schwarz said that ScotAm was one of a number of current opportunities which fulfilled the group's criteria.

"We are looking to acquire businesses in the UK and U.S. with quality local management, marketing and distribution in place which, with the backing of AMP's financial strength and AAA rating, can deliver substantial organic growth."
He said AMP was looking for a way of offering the best possible value to policyholders and developing ScotAm as a thriving and growing business within the AMP group.

Schwarz also said AMP believed it would be wrong to handicap discussions with ScotAm by conducting them in the "glare of publicity" and so would not be requiring ScotAm to make its offer public under the terms of ScotAm's offer process.
